decisions: Reviews section uses a three-column ledger-table layout (id | title/cat | right-aligned date) with stronger top/bottom rules — distinct HTML structure from Newsletter/Articles which share the 2-col dispatch catalog pattern.
Newsletter masthead uses 'The Hangman Chronicles' as both <title> and <h1> per the brief; config.label ('Newsletter') appears only in the breadcrumb nav.

PostLayout switches from define:vars with hardcoded light-mode hex values to an ACCENT_VAR map that references CSS custom properties (var(--accent-newsletter) etc.), giving dark-mode-aware per-section coloring.
PageHeader updated to use Edition tokens (Fraunces h1 at weight 400, --font-mono subtitles, --gold counts, 2px ruled border-bottom) — this uniformly improves all consumers: bylines, archive, topics.
Bylines index keeps PostCardList (with CldImage support) since bylines frequently have publication logos; the section index pages for the Big 3 use bespoke rendering without card images.
About and contact pages get Edition-native mastheads rather than using PageHeader, since they have unique sub-structure (prose body vs. definition list).
Step 9 handles bylines uniform treatment via updated PageHeader (applies to bylines/index.astro); no separate restructuring needed since bylines already used PageHeader.
assumptions: SECTION_META for article and review falls back to config.label (from CATEGORY_CONFIG) for h1 — no custom name like 'The Hangman Chronicles' exists for those sections.
Cloudinary figures in post bodies are fully styled via global.css (figure.img-small/medium/large/full) and require no PostLayout changes — confirmed by grep of dist/ output.
The 'ruled ledger-table device from the mockup' maps to: horizontal rules between rows, right-aligned date column, compact row height with gold accent on the ID column.
